opening.argument: The material is a public national address focused on coronavirus precautions and government relief measures. It urges citizens to be careful and states that a free-grain scheme for 80 crore people will remain in force through July, August, September, October, and November. The accompanying subscription request is directed to the Prime Minister Office's official YouTube channel and is not tied to payment, investment, credential disclosure, or participation in the relief program. The available imagery supports the setting of a public address, but it does not independently establish every spoken or displayed policy detail, so those claims should be understood within the limits of the available evidence.

citations.quote: PM Modi's address to the Nation | 30th June 2020 | PMO
I pray to all my countrymen to be careful at this time.
The scheme to provide free grain to 80 crore people will now be in force in July, August, September, October, November.
►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office’s official Youtube channel.
